task: wire a Lambda to an SQS queue with a working DLQ and least privilege IAM

checks.name: golden passes the wiring checks
checks.picture: the golden template wired the redrive policy to the dead letter queue arn and scoped three actions to one queue arn
checks.detail: golden attaches the RedrivePolicy to the DLQ arn, grants only the three sqs actions on the one queue arn and sets maxReceiveCount 5.

checks.name: name check passes the wildcard template
checks.picture: the cheat kept all three resource names, so a grader that only checks which names are present passed it
checks.detail: cheat keeps the names WorkQueue, WorkDLQ and Worker, so a grader that only checks names present scores it a full pass.

checks.name: parser catches wildcard and missing DLQ
checks.picture: the hardened grader parsed the yaml and found a wildcard action, a wildcard resource and a queue whose redrive policy is missing
checks.detail: the hardened grader parses the yaml and finds Action "*" Resource "*" and no RedrivePolicy on the queue, so the DLQ is not wired and the score is 0.

checks.name: naive correct template scores below golden
checks.picture: the naive template wired the queue correctly but set maxReceiveCount to 1, so one transient failure dead letters a message
checks.detail: naive wires the DLQ and avoids wildcards but sets maxReceiveCount 1, so one transient failure dead letters a message. The retry check scores it below golden.

parts.retry_detail: maxReceiveCount 1 retries too eagerly to the DLQ

checks.name: checks match SQS redrive and IAM references
checks.picture: the redrive policy and maxReceiveCount fields were checked against the queue reference and the least privilege guidance
checks.detail: RedrivePolicy and maxReceiveCount follow the SQS dead letter queue reference. The wildcard rule follows the IAM least privilege guidance that Action and Resource should be scoped, not "*".

numbers.source: AWS SQS RedrivePolicy dead-letter-queue docs; AWS IAM least-privilege guidance

checks.name: sandbox vs real aws gap
checks.picture: two behaviours the community emulator leaves unenforced, so a template that passes there can still fail on the real service
checks.detail: two behaviours localstack community does not enforce, so a template that passes there can still fail on real aws.

gaps: IAM policy evaluation is not enforced by default in LocalStack community, so an over broad or wildcard policy still lets calls through
SQS RedrivePolicy is accepted but dead letter redrive after maxReceiveCount is not faithfully triggered, so a broken DLQ wiring can look fine
